jobs.title: Product Manager II — Identity Operations Platform
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.

 **Job Description**

Experian's Consumer Services (ECS)

Experian's Digital Identity team is seeking a Product Manager II to reimagine how we run one of the most critical systems in consumer finance: the identity layer that helps tens of millions of people prove who they are, access their accounts, and stay protected from fraud. This is a chance to help define what modern identity operations look like — and to build it from the ground up.

As Product Manager II, you will shape and own the product strategy for an operations platform that helps our teams detect issues as they emerge, understand root cause quickly, and resolve problems with less manual effort. You'll bring modern tooling and automation to make our identity systems more observable, more resilient, and easier to run. Working across our teams you'll have unusual breadth, high visibility, and the opportunity to grow a capability that will scale well beyond its starting point.

**Responsibilities**

* Define the vision and roadmap for an operations platform that gives Digital Identity a real-time, end-to-end understanding of how our consumer journeys, systems, and partner integrations are performing.
* Shorten the path from detecting an issue to resolving it by improving how teams monitor, investigate, and respond across the identity ecosystem.
* Identify high-friction manual workflows across teams and lead their transformation into streamlined, automated processes that free people to focus on higher-value work.
* Bring consistency to how we monitor and evaluate third-party identity and fraud partners, so performance shifts are detected once, shared broadly, and acted on quickly.
* Partner closely with engineering, data science, analytics, and pod leaders to turn ambiguous operational challenges into well-defined problems, clear requirements, and measurable outcomes.
* Evaluate emerging tools and techniques — including AI where it adds real value — through focused proofs of concept, and scale the approaches that prove their worth.
* Look across pods to spot recurring patterns and build reusable capabilities that make every team faster, rather than solving the same problem in isolation.

 **Qualifications**  

* 10+ years of experience in which 3+ years of product management or related experience building software products.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business/Marketing, or a technical field preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to turn complex, cross-team problems into a structured, prioritized plan and see it through to delivery.
* Comfort influencing across multiple teams and stakeholders without direct authority.
* Strong analytical skills and a metrics-driven approach to decision-making.
* Experience with observability, monitoring, platform, or internal tooling products is a plus.
* Familiarity with applying automation or AI tools to operational problems is a plus.
* Background in identity, authentication, fraud, or financial services is a plus.
* You will directly report to Director.

  
**Additional Information**

Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people first, inclusive and purpose driven culture is multi award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or explore our Careers Site to understand why. Experian is also proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.

Recruitment Fraud Awareness - Experian's recruitment process is conducted only through authorised channels. Recruitment communications will only be sent from an @experian.com email address.

Experian will never ask candidates to make any payment as part of an application, interview, assessment, onboarding, or recruitment process. To apply for roles or verify opportunities, please visit experian.com/careers

**Life at Experian**

* **Support for every family:** Maternity, paternity and adoption leave for all parents, plus subsidised childcare for all employees.
* **Care when it matters most:** Employee Assistance Program, Mental Health First Aiders, and compassionate and domestic violence leave.
* **Flexibility that fits your life:** Flexible work arrangements with generous annual, sick and family care leave.
* **A community where you belong:** Employee Resource Groups, paid volunteer leave and recognition through our One Experian program.
* **Growth at every stage:** Career mentoring, Harvard Manage Mentor, Experian University and e-learning platforms.

**Job Overview:**

The Omni IVR Product Owner will be responsible for defining, prioritizing, and delivering enhancements that improve the customer voice experience through natural language understanding, intelligent call routing, and contact center automation. * Own day-to-day Product Owner responsibilities, including backlog refinement, story prioritization, dependency management, sprint planning support, requirement clarification, and coordination with delivery teams to ensure roadmap commitments are executed successfully.

**What are we looking for?**
----------------------------

We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates **pursue greatness**, **act with integrity**, and are **driven to help our clients succeed**. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we **win together** and **create and share joy** in our work.

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* 7–8 years of experience working with voice systems, IVR platforms, contact center technologies, or related customer service technology solutions.

* Working knowledge of Agile delivery practices, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, PI planning, demos, testing support, and production readiness activities.
* Ability to translate business needs, caller experience goals, and operational requirements into clear features, user stories, call flow changes, and measurable delivery outcomes.

----------------------

* Advanced collaboration and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work effectively across Product Management, technology, operations, analytics, UX, vendors, and business stakeholders to drive shared outcomes.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and influencing skills, including the ability to lead requirement discussions, clarify complex needs, manage competing priorities, and build alignment across diverse teams.
* Value-driven product ownership mindset, with the ability to balance client experience, operational efficiency, technical feasibility, roadmap priorities, and delivery commitments while acting with integrity and helping the team win together.

**Preferences:**
----------------

* Experience with natural language understanding, conversational IVR, speech recognition, text-to-speech, intent design, call routing logic, or voice bot capabilities.
* Familiarity with contact center platforms, telephony technologies, CRM integrations, routing strategies, call flow design, or service center operations.
* Experience using data, reporting, or performance metrics such as containment, misroutes, transfer rates, call volume, average handle time, and customer experience trends to identify improvement opportunities.
* Proficiency with Agile delivery tools and documentation practices, such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Visio, or similar tools used for backlog management, process flows, and requirement traceability.

jobs.description:
Agile Product Owner Senior Advisor
  
  
**Position Overview:**  
The Agile Product Owner Senior Advisor is a strategic and collaborative leader within an agile development team, responsible for managing the product backlog and ensuring that development efforts align with customer needs and business goals. This role involves translating high-level business requirements into clear, actionable features, defining acceptance criteria, and prioritizing work to maximize value delivery. The Product Owner serves as the voice of the customer, working closely with developers, architects, operations, and business stakeholders to guide product development through iterative cycles.
  
The Product Owner should embrace the “Product Mindset” and is expected to understand strategic roadmap goals, conduct customer interviews, analyze data, and participate in portfolio discussions to shape the product vision. They are empowered to support intake, prioritize delivery in partnership with business and Engineering, and ensure the Scrum team is focused on solving the right problems with innovative solutions. This role demands strong business and technical acumen, the ability to communicate effectively across teams, and a commitment to delivering measurable outcomes.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  

* Understand and align product goals with strategic business objectives to ensure delivery of meaningful value.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with business and technology partners, fostering cross-functional collaboration.
* Act as the primary contact for resolving escalations, removing impediments, and managing stakeholder negotiations and conflicts.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to onboard new initiatives and integrate them effectively into the product development lifecycle.
* Support the development of specifications, including value propositions and technical financial estimates, to guide delivery planning.
* Align with delivery teams to understand capacity and ensure prioritization is accurately reflected in the product backlog.
* Own and refine the product backlog, maintaining a steady flow of well-defined work items for the development team.
* Analyze business needs and support requirement gathering, architecture discussions, and design decisions within agile teams.
* Translate business requirements into actionable features and define iteration scope to guide development.
* Participate actively in agile ceremonies and respond to team inquiries, clarifying features and acceptance criteria.
* Communicate the product vision and strategic decisions to the team, reinforcing customer-centric thinking and business rationale.
* Conduct data analysis and profiling to support product decisions, including mapping source-to-target data and investigating issues using tools like SQL, SAS, or Python

**Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in MIS, Business, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 14-16 years of experience in data analysis; Healthcare data domain experience and Agile certification (e.g., SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager) are highly desirable.
* Demonstrated experience as a Product Owner or in a similar role within Agile development environments, with a strong grasp of Agile principles, Scrum methodology, and modern delivery practices such as continuous integration and test-driven development.
* Proven ability to translate complex business needs into clear, actionable features and acceptance criteria, with a focus on delivering customer-centric solutions.
* Aptitude for gaining deep knowledge of the industry, business strategy, and key data domains (e.g., provider data, claims, membership, benefits), and proactively applying this knowledge to drive meaningful results.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship management skills, with the ability to facilitate collaboration across multiple functions, departments, and levels.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills, with the ability to influence and negotiate effectively across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Proficiency in Agile and collaboration tools (JIRA) with hands-on experience supporting agile ceremonies and backlog management.
* Advanced data analysis capabilities, including experience with SQL tools (e.g.,Toad, SAS, Alation), and data profiling techniques; familiarity with cloud technologies and data warehousing is a plus.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate code, decode data issues, and support architecture and design decisions.
* Exceptional organizational and work management skills, with experience managing dependencies, risks, and delivery timelines in dynamic, lean/agile environments.

**Required Skills:**  

* Data Analytics Platforms (Databricks and/or Snowflake)
* Python, DevOps, Basic Cloud Experience (AWS/Azure)

**Preferred Skills, Experience Education:**  

* Cloud Certification (AWS Cloud Practitioner or similar)

Evernorth Health Services, a division of The Cigna Group, creates pharmacy, care and benefit solutions to improve health and increase vitality. We relentlessly innovate to make the prediction, prevention and treatment of illness and disease more accessible to millions of people. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

Work from evidence

Manage stakeholders across regions

Work effectively across time zones with counterparts in the US and EMEA..

Bachelor's degree, or equivalent experience.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description Summary**
Build the field software that helps maintain and update information about the network for Electric, Gas, Water or Telecommunications.
  
  
When work happens in the Field, whether its event driven, maintenance activities, or other planned work, We build the software those crews and Field Engineers use. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead continued improvements to the products at the center of that work: GridOS Field and its unified App and User Experience. One field app supporting many complex business flows and outcomes
  
  
This role owns how utility field workers capture critical information while performing work. Your decisions will shape how quickly and efficiently utilities capture and maintain data that is constantly changing in the Field.
  
  
**Job Description**
Own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery for product and workflow inside GridOS Field. Your day to day will include:
  
  

* Owning the roadmap. Set direction for new workflows and enhancements to GridOS Field. Prioritize based on customer needs, technology changes, regulatory drivers, and business impact.
* Working with customers. Spend time with utility damage assessors, field supervisors, and control room staff. Validate real problems before writing a single requirement.
* Working with your Peer Product Management teams who also manage the product lifecycle of GridOS Field
* Driving delivery. Partner with engineering, design, and UX to ship high quality releases on a predictable cadence. Support the Lean operating rhythm.
* Working with Requirements Management tools: These tools help document and drive the roadmaps and priorities that help shape strategy, delivery and on-going improvements to GridOS Field
* Connecting to the platform. Make sure your products feel like one app with the rest of GridOS Field. Work with the UX PM and the other GridOS Field PMs to keep the experience unified.
* Using AI. Apply AI to speed up damage triage, image capture workflows, and data quality checks. Use AI tools in your own workflow to move faster.
* Supporting sales and delivery. Join customer calls, write positioning material, and help account teams win and deliver deals with Southern Company, PPL, and the accounts that follow them.
* Guiding customers off legacy. Help utilities move from FieldSmart, AEMS, and other legacy tools onto the modern GridOS Field platform.

What You'll Bring
  
  

* Product management or other Management experience with complex enterprise software, ideally in utilities, energy, telecom, or another regulated industry.
* Working knowledge of utility field operations, outage restoration, or ADMS/DMS/OMS and other Field Maintenance Flows. If you have not lived it, you have shipped software to people who have.
* A track record of running more than one program at a time with a clear, data-driven approach.
* Comfort with AI tools in your own product workflow.
* Strong writing and communication. You can turn a messy customer conversation into a clear requirement, a crisp roadmap update, or a one-page memo.
* Commercial judgment. You can connect a product decision to a revenue, cost, or customer outcome.
* A Lean and Agile mindset. You adjust quickly when priorities shift, and you close things out.

Education Requirements
  
  
**For US candidates:**
A Master's degree, or a High School Diploma/GED with at least six years of professional experience.
  
  
**For non-US candidates:**
A Master's equivalent, or a High School Diploma with relevant professional experience.
  
  
Why Join Us
  
  
You will work on software that utilities depend on during their most challenging times to maintain infrastructure stability while experiencing exponential growth in demand. restoring service.
  
  
**We Offer**

* Real impact. Providing Value to Large Tier 1 and Tier2 Utility and Telco companies, with a clear runway to grow.
* Modern stack. Single-tenant SaaS on hyperscaler infrastructure, with AI built in through the Prism platform.
* Direct customer contact. You talk to the people using the product, not just the people buying it.
* Growth. GridOS Field is scaling. Strong PMs move up.

Success in This Role
  
  
You will know you are succeeding when the Adoption rate of GridOS Field increasing and becomes a key part of both our existing customer base and prospects.
  
  
Working Arrangement
  
  
Permanent, fully remote. Occasional travel to customer sites and GE Vernova offices.
  
  
We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applications from everyone who meets the criteria and is interested in the future of the grid.
  
  
******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
No

jobs.title: Product Manager-Senior Product Specialist
jobs.description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Product Management**
**Deloitte Consulting Products (USI)**
**About The Role**
Deloitte is looking for a hands-on product manager to own a product end-to-end within Deloitte Consulting Products. Based in US-India (USI Office), you'll own the day-to-day of a product built for the US market—running discovery, shaping the roadmap, and working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering and design to ship value clients actually use.
  
  
This is a builder's role at its core. You're the strongest product craftsperson on your product: closest to the user, closest to the backlog, and accountable for the outcomes it delivers. You'll work with US-based product owners, sponsors, and offering leaders to stay grounded in the market you're building for.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Own Your Product**

* Own the roadmap, backlog, and outcomes for your product, turning priorities into a clear plan of what to build next
* Make the day-to-day prioritization and trade-off calls, sequencing work by value, effort, and readiness
* Define and track the metrics that show it's working: adoption, engagement, retention, impact
* Know when something isn't working—flag it early and make the case to change course or stop

**Discover & Validate**

* Run discovery to understand your users and the problems worth solving, partnering with US product owners, sponsors, and offering leaders
* Frame and test hypotheses through user research, prototypes, and rapid validation before building at scale
* Use both generative and evaluative research to answer “are we building the right thing?” and “are we building it right?”

**Ship as One Team**

* Take features and products from concept through define, shape, build, and scale
* Own the product backlog: write clear problem statements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, and keep it groomed and prioritized
* Work as one team with engineering and UX—sprint planning, reviews, and the daily calls that keep delivery moving
* Own launch, adoption, and iteration; instrument the product and act on what the data shows
* Work in an AI-native way, using AI and agentic workflows across discovery, build, and delivery to move faster without cutting corners

**Clients & Go-to-Market**

* Stay close to clients—join demos, discovery sessions, and feedback conversations, and turn what you hear into the roadmap
* Support go-to-market with product marketing, sales, and account teams: positioning, demos, and enablement
* Stay fluent in the US market realities that shape your product: data privacy, SaaS vs. on-prem

**Work Across the Network**

* Partner with Deloitte Consulting Delivery and Practice teams across India to align your product with delivery capacity and real client needs, and be the go-to for questions on your product
* Mentor and lift the product managers and associates around you, modeling strong product craft

**Reporting Relationships**
Reports to a Senior Manager / AVP of Product Management. Works as one team with engineering and UX, partners with US-based product owners, sponsors, and offering leaders, and collaborates with GTM, account, and Deloitte Consulting Delivery and Practice teams across India.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Required**

* 6+ years in product management or product ownership, including owning a product end-to-end
* Track record of shipping products or major features from discovery to launch, with measurable outcomes
* Strong hands-on product craft: backlog, user stories and acceptance criteria, and working day to day with engineering and design in an agile setup
* Fluent in discovery and validation—user research, hypotheses, prototypes—not just delivery
* Comfortable client-facing, including product demos and discovery with senior stakeholders
* Based in India, able to work virtually with US stakeholders on US-market direction and its nuances

**Preferred**

* Seasoned as a Product Owner in an agile / Scrum environment
* Zero-to-one product or feature launch experience
* Products, professional services, consulting, or enterprise-technology background
* Experience mentoring junior product owners

**Core Competencies**

* Owns outcomes, not just outputs
* Problem-obsessed and customer-centric
* Strong product craft and delivery discipline
* Bias to action—ships, learns, iterates
* Clear communicator with engineering, design, and stakeholders
* Data-driven, with sound judgment

**Why This Role Matters**
Great products are built by people who stay close to the user and close to the craft. This role owns a product built for the US market from the ground in India—discovering what to build, shipping it as one team with engineering and design, and iterating on what clients actually use. It's where strong product managers do their best hands-on work and grow into the leaders who own portfolios next.
  
  
**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership …

jobs.title: Senior Hardware Product Manager - IoT Wireless/IC Design
jobs.description:
Silicon Labs (NASDAQ: SLAB) is the leading innovator in low-power wireless connectivity, building embedded technology that connects devices and improves lives. Merging cutting-edge technology into the world’s most highly integrated SoCs, Silicon Labs provides device makers the solutions, support, and ecosystems needed to create advanced edge connectivity applications. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, Silicon Labs has operations in over 16 countries and is the trusted partner for innovative solutions in the smart home, industrial IoT, and smart cities markets. Learn more at www.silabs.com.

**Meet the Team**

IoT is the only focus area for Silicon Labs and is one of the most visible and fastest growing segments of the semiconductor industry. Our portfolio of industry leading wireless solutions includes Bluetooth, Zigbee, Thread, Z-Wave, Wi-Fi, Wi-Sun, Proprietary Wireless and other emerging technologies driving the next generation of IoT smart connected products. With the addition of AI acceleration, rich MCU content combined with best-in-class software stacks, tools and development environments we offer compulsive and complete solutions to customers.

As a member of the Hardware Product Management team, you will be responsible for the Silicon Labs IoT products starting from concept to plan and customer alphas. You will be required to interact with a wide range of cross functional teams including silicon design, product test, validation, software product management & engineering, project management and business management to ensure the best of the products come to the market.

As a team, hardware product management:

* Provides leadership and vision on IC product roadmap and requirements.
* Continuously improves our portfolio offering, balancing business needs with R&D efficiency.
* Creates product roadmaps based on various segment inputs to meet the requirements for a diverse range of applications

This is one of the few functions where you will have the great opportunity to discuss with top executives regarding strategy and execution on a day-to-day basis, thus having invaluable amount of learning.

Come and join us in our goal to become the undisputed leader in wireless connectivity for IoT!

**Responsibilities**

* Define SoC product requirements, features, specifications, and system KPIs for core CPU, co-processors, accelerators, power management, digital and analog peripherals, security sub-system, radio sub-system, and packages.
* Map market systems application requirements to product use cases, including system block diagrams, compute and peripheral requirements, and protocol stack features and performance requirements for Wi-Fi, Matter, Thread, ZigBee, Bluetooth Low Energy, Bluetooth Classic, Sidewalk, Wi-SUN, and proprietary protocols.
* Define hardware and evaluation tools for customers, including debug interfaces such as JTAG, SWD, ETM trace, PTI, virtual communication port requirements, and user interfaces such as push buttons, LCDs, LEDs, analog joysticks, and RHT sensors.
* Collaborate with leaders and individual contributors across functional teams such as IC design, product test, software development, product and segment marketing, applications, operations, and sales to develop long-term innovation ideas, roadmap, and silicon definition.
* Drive the product development process from concept through definition and pitch the most promising product ideas to executive staff.
* Conduct key competitive analysis, including tear-down at the die level and various spec analyses, to provide conclusive takeaways for design, specification, and fighting guides.
* Manage the entire portfolio of scalable products with clear mapping to target applications.

**Skills You Will Need**

*Minimum Qualifications*

* BSEE/BSCS (or equivalent) and 10+ years of experience in semiconductor product management or IoT industry
* Core development experience in IC front end / architecture / verification / embedded systems
* Knowledge of key architectural considerations for PPA, including power estimation, die size estimation, and fundamental process node technology principles.
* Knowledge of Wireless Modem and RF Design principles for any of Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, 802.15.4, and other Low Power Wireless standards
* Proven ability to work successfully at a technical level with cross-functional engineering teams, including hardware and software engineers
* Experience developing business cases for Technology investments working with Business Unit partners, sensitivity analysis of business case to variables under consideration.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, especially to executive management

*The following qualifications will be considered a plus:*

* Development experience in either wireless or wired communication protocols
* MBA or equivalent business graduation

Benefits & Perks

Not only will you be joining a highly skilled and tight-knit team where every engineer makes a significant impact on the product; we also strive for good work/life balance and to make our environment welcoming and fun.

· Equity Rewards (RSUs)

· Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

· Insurance plans with Outpatient cover

· National Pension Scheme (NPS)

· Flexible work policy

· Childcare support.

jobs.title: Senior Product Owner, India
jobs.description:
**About Us**
DriveWealth is on a mission to make investing easier. We believe that everyone should have the ability to control their financial future, and that access to financial markets should not be limited by geography, wealth, or legacy systems. We are a global B2B financial technology organization dedicated to democratizing access to financial independence around the world. Our mission is realized through an API-based platform, empowering our partners to offer seamless investing and trading experiences to clients worldwide, all from their mobile devices. Our technology provides partners with a modern, extensible toolkit, enabling traditional investment workflows and innovative techniques like fractional share ownership. DriveWealth has evolved into a global platform offering trading of US equities, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income, and options.
  
  
There’s never been a better time to build a category-defining business and there has rarely been a team better positioned for this opportunity. Our culture blends the pace and agility of a fintech start-up with the impact, stability, and discipline of Wall Street. We encourage creativity and experimentation while ensuring institutional-grade execution and regulatory compliance in everything we do. Join us and help build the future of global investing!
  
  
**About The Role**
This is the first product role DriveWealth has placed in-market, and you will own what it becomes. You are the product voice for our partners in India across the full platform: equities, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income, and options, plus the account opening and money movement capabilities underneath them. Partners in this market bring requirements that are specific, sometimes ambiguous, and always urgent, and your job is to convert them into scoped, sequenced, shipped work. You will not run a dedicated engineering team. Your leverage comes from judgment, credibility, and your ability to pull the right product owners and engineering leads across the platform onto the right problem. You own the call on which requests become roadmap, which get an alternative solution, and which get a clear no. You will work in close partnership with our regional Head of Sales, and you will represent this function directly to partners and to product leadership. Success in year one looks like partners in India who feel heard, a delivery record they can point to, and a repeatable model we can stand up in the next jurisdiction.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Become the primary product point of contact for our partners in India, and build the relationships that surface real requirements before they become escalations
* Translate partner asks across all asset classes, accounts, and money movement into requirements, user stories, and documentation that other product owners and engineering teams can execute against without a translation layer
* Sequence and track delivery across multiple product domains, holding the through-line from request to launch when no single team owns the whole thing
* Partner with the regional Head of Sales on commercial context, partner priorities, and competitive pressure in-market
* Test every request against platform capability and local jurisdictional requirements, and propose the alternative when the answer is no
* Spot the patterns across requests that point to a platform gap, and drive them into the appropriate domain roadmap yourself
* Decide when to push back, when to escalate, and when to absorb complexity to keep delivery moving, without needing that judgment checked
* Speak for this function in partner, sales, and product leadership forums on status, tradeoffs, and constraints
* Write the playbook for in-market product delivery, with an eye to what should scale to the next jurisdiction

**You Bring**

* Minimum 7 years of experience in Financial Services and/or Fintech or equivalent industries, in product management, business analysis, or a senior partner-facing technical role
* Bachelor's Degree in computer science, engineering, finance, or equivalent in relevant experience
* Experience with trading platforms, brokerage, or fintech infrastructure
* Experience analyzing data using SQL and relevant BI tools
* FINRA Securities Industry Essentials (SIE) completion, or a commitment to acquire within the first year with support from your Manager
* A track record of ownership and disciplined execution in high-stakes environments
* The ability to prioritize ruthlessly, focussing on what’s critical versus important to drive work to completion
* A client-oriented mindset with an understanding of how your work impacts partners
* Strength in cross-functional partnership with the judgment to coordinate across multiple teams
* A bias toward transparency, accountability, and responsiveness in everything you do
* You’re committed to continuous improvement and implicitly believe that we > I.
* Impeccable high integrity, sound judgment, and a deep respect for risk, control, and operational excellence

**Location**
This role is open to candidates in the following locations:
**Hyderabad, IN**
- On-site
  
  

* This role is expected to come into the office on a cadence set by the Hiring Manager/Team.
* If you're not based in one of the location listed above, this role is not a fit, and we cannot accommodate remote work outside this location.

**Working at DriveWealth**
We do our best work when we're in the same room. To maintain the speed our partners expect, our New York, Chicago, and Lithuania teams work in office on a hybrid schedule. We've found that being physically side-by-side is the only way to solve complex problems in real-time and stay truly accountable to the products we ship. When you're here, you're working directly with the people making the decisions.

In this role, you will serve as the bridge between commercial stakeholders and our advanced AI engineering team.

You must possess a deep understanding of business domains alongside a strong technical grounding in Artificial Intelligence, Large Language Models (LLMs), and autonomous agent workflows. **Responsibilities**

* Partner with the AI Development Lead to deconstruct high-level product features into comprehensive Work Breakdown Structures (WBS)
* Write highly descriptive, value-driven Epics and User Stories with clear Acceptance Criteria that account for the non-deterministic nature of AI outputs
* Own, groom, and prioritize the product backlog based on ROI, user impact, and technical dependencies defined by the engineering lead
* Translate complex business rules and industry domain knowledge into logic that AI engineers can use to build agent prompts, tools, and cognitive routing

* Actively participate in daily standups, sprint planning, and sprint reviews, acting as the ultimate voice of the customer

**Requirements**

* 10-15 years of experience in Product Management, including defining Product Vision and owning the Product Roadmap
* Expertise in Agile or SAFe frameworks, with extensive experience working as a Product Owner in Scrum or Kanban environments
* Understanding of AI Solutions, AI Content Framework, and AI Risk Management
* Knowledge of Generative AI, LLM capabilities (e.g., Google Gemini ecosystem), and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
* Familiarity with function calling and multi-agent orchestration concepts (no coding required, but strong conceptual grasp is essential)
* Proven ability to map business processes, identify operational bottlenecks, and quantify the ROI of automation features
* Capability to manage product lifecycles for non-deterministic software where AI outputs are not always 100% predictable
* Proficiency in Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps

* Exceptional ability to explain technical AI constraints to business users and business nuances to technical engineers
* English proficiency at an Upper-Intermediate level (B2) or higher

* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO) designation
* Background in Business Analysis or Systems Analysis with a later specialization in AI/ML products

jobs.title: Lead Business Analyst - AI Framework
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly analytical and strategically minded **Product Owner (PO) for AI & Agentic Products** to drive the vision, strategy, and execution of our AI-driven product portfolio. In this role, you will be the bridge between commercial stakeholders and our advanced AI engineering team.

You must possess a deep understanding of business domains alongside a strong technical grounding in Artificial Intelligence, Large Language Models (LLMs), and autonomous agent workflows. Working closely with our AI Development Lead, you will translate high-level business requirements into granular user stories, actively participate in building Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), and ensure the engineering team is building AI solutions that deliver measurable business impact.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with business leaders, domain experts, and end-users to discover, define, and document comprehensive business requirements
* Evaluate business problems through an AI lens — determining whether a problem is best solved via deterministic software, traditional ML, or generative AI/agentic workflows
* Define, maintain, and communicate the product roadmap, balancing short-term business wins with long-term technical architecture sustainability
* Partner with the AI Development Lead to deconstruct high-level product features into comprehensive Work Breakdown Structures (WBS)
* Write highly descriptive, value-driven Epics and User Stories. Define clear Acceptance Criteria that account for the non-deterministic nature of AI outputs
* Own, groom, and prioritize the product backlog based on ROI, user impact, and technical dependencies defined by the engineering lead
* Translate complex business rules and industry domain knowledge into logic that AI engineers can use to build agent prompts, tools, and cognitive routing
* Work with the engineering team to define "what success looks like" for AI agents, helping establish performance benchmarks, evaluation datasets, and user feedback loops
* Actively participate in daily standups, sprint planning, and sprint reviews, acting as the ultimate voice of the customer

**Requirements**

* Solid conceptual understanding of Generative AI, LLM capabilities (e.g., Google Gemini ecosystem), RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), function calling, and multi-agent orchestration. You don't need to code it, but you must know how it works
* Proven ability to map business processes, identify operational bottlenecks, and quantify the return on investment (ROI) of automation features
* Comfort with managing product lifecycles for non-deterministic software (where AI outputs are not always 100% predictable)
* Extensive experience working as a Product Owner in Scrum or Kanban environments, using tools like Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps
* Proven track record of breaking down complex enterprise requirements into logical, incremental software delivery phases (MVP approach)
* Exceptional ability to explain technical AI constraints to business users and business nuances to technical engineers

**Nice to have**

* Prior experience acting as a Product Owner or Product Manager for data science, machine learning, or generative AI products
* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO) designation
* Background in Business Analysis or Systems Analysis with a later specialization in AI/ML products

We build modern enterprise integration solutions using cloud-native architectures, event-driven technologies, and AI-enabled software engineering. Join us to deliver secure, scalable, and intelligent integration platforms.

 **Job Description**

Senior Software Engineer – Enterprise Application Integration (EAI)

**Location:** Hyderabad, India

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to design, develop, deploy, and support enterprise integration solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This hands-on role focuses on building scalable APIs, event-driven microservices, and cloud-native applications while leveraging AI-powered development tools to improve engineering productivity and solution quality.  
  
The ideal candidate has strong experience with Node.js, TypeScript, Kafka, and GCP, and is comfortable adopting AI-assisted development tools and applying emerging AI technologies to business solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and maintain enterprise integration services, REST APIs, and event-driven microservices using Node.js and TypeScript.
* Build scalable, secure, and high-performance solutions utilizing Kafka, Solo Enterprise Gateway, and Google Cloud Platform.
* Develop reusable components following enterprise architecture, coding standards, and security best practices.
* Lead production support and release deployments for enterprise integration applications, services, and APIs
* Drive incident resolution, root cause analysis, and long-term reliability improvements
* Perform code reviews, write automated tests, troubleshoot production issues, and mentor junior engineers.
* Participate in architecture discussions and Agile ceremonies.
* Use AI-assisted development tools (Gemini, ChatGPT, Cursor, or similar) to improve coding, testing, documentation, and debugging.
* Evaluate and integrate AI capabilities into enterprise applications where appropriate.
* Leverage LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and AI services to improve business processes and developer productivity.
* Collaborate with architects, product owners, QA, and support teams to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions.
* Contribute to continuous improvement, engineering standards, and technical documentation, and operational best practices
* Stay current with emerging AI technologies and recommend practical adoption opportunities.

  
**Qualifications**

Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).

Experience: 6+ years building enterprise APIs, microservices, integration platforms, and cloud-native applications with production support experience.

Technical Skills

* Strong proficiency in Node.js and TypeScript.
* Experience with Kafka (Confluent preferred) and GCP (Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Cloud Functions, Firestore, Cloud Tasks).
* Experience with API Gateways (Gloo/Solo Enterprise preferred)
* Knowledge of REST APIs, event-driven architecture, microservices, Docker, Git, GitLab CI/CD, Terraform, ArgoCD, relational and NoSQL databases.
* Understanding of secure software development and API management.
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor, or similar.
* Familiarity with prompt engineering and integrating LLM APIs.
* Knowledge of Vertex AI, OpenAI APIs, LangChain, RAG, or AI agents is a plus.

  
**Additional Information**

Skills & Competencies

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
* Ownership mindset with passion for innovation, AI adoption, and continuous learning.

The role serves as the primary regional DT partner for Supply Chain, Planning, Customer Service, Order Management, Logistics and Distribution, connecting the Global Product direction with AMEA business priorities, cluster requirements, Enterprise & TLT CoE delivery and sustainment.

The scope spans the end-to-end Plan & Deliver lifecycle: demand and supply planning, S&OP/IBP, production and inventory planning, supplier and network planning, deployment planning, customer and product master-data dependencies, Order-to-Cash (O2C), customer service and order management, fulfilment, warehousing, transportation, shipment visibility, distribution and related integrations.

jobs.title: Sr Product Owner - Technical Product Management [T500-28887]
jobs.description:
**About T-Mobile:**

T-Mobile US, Inc. (NASDAQ: TMUS), headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, is America’s supercharged Un-carrier, connecting millions through its strong nationwide network and flagship brands, T-Mobile and Metro by T-Mobile. Customers benefit from an unmatched combination of value, quality, and exceptional service experience.

**TMUS Global Solutions:**

TMUS Global Solutions
is a world-class technology powerhouse accelerating the company’s global digital transformation. With a culture built on growth, inclusivity, and global collaboration, the teams here drive innovation at scale, powered by bold thinking.

**About the Role:**

The Senior Product Owner is accountable for backlog strategy, prioritization, and requirements definition for T-Mobile’s offshore AI Platform & Reliability Engineering organization. This role owns what gets built and in what order across AI platform capabilities, agent systems, platform engineering initiatives, reliability improvements, technical debt reduction, and operational excellence investments. The role ensures engineering investments remain aligned with business priorities while balancing feature delivery, platform sustainability, operational excellence, and technical debt reduction.

The Senior Product Owner serves as the product-side decision-maker for backlog prioritization, partnering closely with the Manager, Software Engineering - AI Platform & Reliability Engineering, who owns delivery execution, engineering operations, people leadership, and production reliability. The role reports to the Manager with a dotted-line relationship to onshore Product Management to ensure alignment with strategic product direction.

Success is measured through prioritization quality, roadmap alignment, backlog readiness, reduction of engineering rework, stakeholder alignment, and the team’s ability to consistently execute against business and platform objectives. We pride ourselves on encouraging a culture of innovation, agile ways of working, and transparency in all we do. Join us in embodying the spirit of the Un-carrier and making a tangible impact.

**What You'll Do:**

* Own backlog strategy, prioritization, and sequencing across AI platform capabilities, platform engineering initiatives, reliability improvements, technical debt, and operational excellence investments.
* Translate product strategy and roadmap objectives into well-defined epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria that are ready for engineering execution.
* Partner with engineering managers, architects, and technical leads to ensure backlog priorities align with platform architecture, engineering capacity, and business objectives.
* Balance competing priorities across feature delivery, platform sustainability, scalability, reliability, and technical debt while clearly communicating tradeoffs.
* Prioritize AI platform capabilities including agent orchestration, conversational platforms, SDKs, enterprise integrations, and Model Context Protocol (MCP)-enabled capabilities.
* Ensure production readiness, operational excellence, and reliability engineering initiatives are appropriately represented within backlog priorities.
* Collaborate with onshore Product Management to align offshore engineering execution with product strategy and roadmap objectives.
* Coordinate dependencies across engineering teams, architects, Product Owners, and platform stakeholders to improve delivery predictability.
* Accept completed work against defined business and technical acceptance criteria.
* Use engineering metrics, operational insights, customer feedback, and platform health indicators to continuously refine backlog priorities and roadmap sequencing.

**What You'll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years of experience in Product Owner, Product Management, Technical Program Management, Engineering, or related roles.
* Demonstrated experience owning prioritization decisions for complex engineering organizations supporting multiple workstreams and competing business priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to operate in technically complex environments involving distributed systems, cloud-native platforms, AI-powered services, platform engineering, or reliability engineering.
* Proven experience managing backlogs that include feature delivery, platform investments, technical debt reduction, and reliability engineering work.
* Strong understanding of APIs, distributed systems, cloud platforms, microservices, data flows, and software delivery practices.
* Experience partnering with engineering managers, architects, and technical leads to balance roadmap objectives with platform sustainability and operational excellence.
* Strong communication, facilitation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.

**Must Have Skills**
:

* Product ownership, backlog strategy, and prioritization
* Technical requirements definition and acceptance criteria
* Agile product delivery and sprint readiness
* Cloud-native platforms, APIs, and distributed systems
* Stakeholder, dependency, and tradeoff management

**Nice-to-Have:**

* Experience working with AI platforms, conversational AI systems, LLM-powered services, or AI infrastructure.
* Experience working with SRE, platform engineering, or cloud operations teams.
* Familiarity with reliability engineering concepts, including SLOs, SLAs, observability, incident management, and operational excellence practices.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to use operational data, usage metrics, and production insights to drive prioritization decisions.
* Experience supporting enterprise-scale platforms serving large customer-facing applications.

jobs.title: Delivery Manager - Java/.NET
jobs.description:
We are seeking an exceptional, business-savvy, and technically accomplished **IT Delivery Manager** with 10 to 14 years of IT industry experience to lead our enterprise software delivery portfolios.

In this role, you will own the strategic delivery roadmap, operational execution, and engineering excellence for multiple cross-functional teams building and modernizing large-scale systems on Java/Spring and/or .NET/C# stacks. You will act as a strategic bridge between executive business leaders, product management, and engineering teams, driving robust Agile delivery frameworks while maintaining high standards of code quality, architecture scalability, and cloud governance.

The ideal candidate has transitioned from a solid technical background (originally as a Software Developer, Tech Lead, or Architect in Java/.NET) into a seasoned delivery leader capable of managing multi-million-dollar portfolios, driving engineering transformations, and mentoring next-generation tech leaders.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Direct and govern the end-to-end delivery of a multi-million-dollar portfolio of enterprise applications built on modern Java and .NET stacks
* Champion and scale Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) across multiple distributed product engineering teams, optimizing velocity, cycle time, and release predictability
* Manage and optimize the portfolio budget, forecasting resource needs, controlling operational expenses (OpEx/CapEx), and ensuring high ROI
* Establish robust delivery governance, identify systemic delivery risks early, and implement proactive mitigation plans to protect critical business timelines and SLAs
* Orchestrate end-to-end software delivery for complex, enterprise-level Java/.NET applications using Agile (Scrum or Kanban) methodologies
* Adapt traditional Agile metrics (team velocity, sprint burn-down, cycle time) to analyze and optimize productivity gains achieved through GenAI tools
* Coordinate sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog grooming, and retrospectives, ensuring development workflows seamlessly integrate AI code generation, automated unit testing, and code review
* Partner closely with Enterprise Architects to guide development teams migrating legacy monolithic codebases into modern cloud-native (AWS, Azure, or GCP) microservices
* Provide high-level technical oversight for teams delivering in Java (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hibernate) or .NET (.NET Core, .NET 8+, C#, ASP.NET Web API)
* Champion continuous improvement in delivery pipelines, driving automated testing, robust CI/CD maturity, DevSecOps adoption, and cloud infrastructure optimization
* Partner with VP/C-level executives, Product Owners, and Business Units to translate long-term business strategy into actionable technical delivery roadmaps, while overseeing offshore/nearshore partners, SOWs, and vendor contracts
* Direct, mentor, and inspire a high-performing organization of Project Managers, Scrum Masters, Tech Leads, and Software Engineers, fostering a culture of psychological safety, accountability, and continuous upskilling (including AI-assisted engineering tools like Copilot)

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a business-related discipline
* 10-14 years of overall IT industry experience, including at least 1-2 years in an IT Delivery Manager, Program Manager, or Delivery Manager role managing multiple concurrent software development teams
* Proven track record of successfully managing enterprise portfolios with budgets exceeding $5M+ and teams of 50+ engineers
* Background in software engineering with hands-on experience in Java (Spring frameworks, Spring Boot, J2EE legacy) and/or .NET (C#, ASP.NET, .NET Core)
* Understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), cloud-native design patterns, and serverless architectures
* Familiarity with containerization technologies such as Kubernetes and Docker
* Knowledge of distributed database environments (SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, NoSQL)
* Expertise in modern integration technologies (Kafka, RabbitMQ, API Gateways)
* Proficiency in scaling Agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) across distributed engineering teams
* Competency in CI/CD maturity, DevSecOps adoption, and automated testing practices
* Capability to manage project scopes, timelines, resource allocation, and multi-million dollar budgets

jobs.title: Business Analyst – Data In-Licensing & Data Governance
jobs.description:
**Job Description: Business Analyst**
– Data In-Licensing & Data Governance Role: Business Analyst – Data In-Licensing & Data Governance Domain: Life Sciences / Pharmaceutical R&D Engagement Focus: Current-State Assessment, Gap Analysis, Requirements Definition & Future State Roadmap Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst with strong knowledge of data governance, data licensing, data lifecycle management, and enterprise data management practices to support an assessment of the Data In-Licensing process within Novartis Biomedical Research (NIBR). The individual will work closely with business, scientific research, data management, legal, procurement, compliance, and technology stakeholders to assess the current operating model, identify process and technology gaps, and recommend improvements to strengthen governance, compliance, traceability, and operational efficiency across the licensed data lifecycle. Key
**Responsibilities**

1. Data In-Licensing Process Assessment Analyze the end-to-end data in-licensing lifecycle, from data acquisition and contractual agreements through onboarding, provisioning, consumption, renewal, expiry, and retirement. Conduct stakeholder interviews and workshops to understand the current operating model, systems, responsibilities, and pain points. Identify manual activities, fragmented workflows, unclear ownership, and opportunities for automation. Prepare AS-IS process maps, gap assessments, and recommended TO-BE workflows.

2. Data Bill of Materials (DBoM) and License Management Define business requirements for a centralized Data Bill of Materials to track all licensed datasets. Identify essential metadata, including data provider, dataset ownership, licensing terms, permitted usage, restrictions, contractual obligations, renewal dates, expiration timelines, and retention requirements. Assess current mechanisms for tracking licensed datasets and their downstream dependencies. Define requirements for notifications, license renewals, compliance checkpoints, and expiry management.

3. Access Governance and Entitlement Management Assess existing Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and entitlement management processes. Map user roles, access privileges, approval workflows, and data usage restrictions to contractual requirements. Identify gaps in access approvals, access reviews, and entitlement revocation. Define business requirements for visibility into who accesses licensed datasets, for what purpose, and under which permissions.

4. Data Lifecycle and Retention Management Evaluate existing practices for data retention, archival, expiration, and secure deletion. Translate contractual retention and deletion obligations into actionable business requirements. Identify gaps in handling expired licenses, downstream copies, and derived datasets. Define requirements for deletion workflows, approvals, exception handling, and evidence of deletion.

5. Auditability, Data Lineage, and Compliance Assess the organization's ability to trace licensed data from acquisition to consumption. Define requirements for audit trails, usage monitoring, and end-to-end data lineage. Identify gaps in demonstrating compliance with contractual usage restrictions and internal governance policies. Work with risk, legal, and compliance stakeholders to define reporting and audit evidence requirements.

6. Gap Analysis and Future-State Recommendations Consolidate findings into a structured gap assessment covering people, process, technology, and governance. Prioritize gaps based on business impact, contractual exposure, operational risk, and implementation complexity. Develop business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and a prioritized improvement backlog. Collaborate with the Data Engineer and solution architects to define feasible remediation options and a phased implementation roadmap.

**Required Skills and Experience**

• 6–10 years of Business Analysis experience, preferably in pharmaceutical, life sciences, research data, or regulated enterprise environments.

• Experience with data governance, data management, data cataloging, and metadata management.

• Understanding of data licensing, contractual data usage restrictions, and third-party data management.

• Strong knowledge of RBAC, access governance, data lifecycle management, and audit requirements.

• Experience with business process mapping, stakeholder workshops, gap assessments, and requirements documentation.

• Familiarity with SQL, relational databases, data lineage concepts, and enterprise data architectures.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Skills**

• Exposure to pharmaceutical R&D or scientific research data ecosystems.

• Experience with data governance/catalog platforms such as Collibra, Informatica, Alation, or equivalent.

• Understanding of GDPR, retention policies, contractual compliance, and internal data governance standards.

• Experience working with Jira, Confluence, Visio, or BPMN modeling tools.

**Expected Deliverables**

• Current-State Data In-Licensing Process Assessment.

• Stakeholder and System Interaction Mapping.

• End-to-End Process and Governance Gap Analysis.

• DBoM Business Requirements and Metadata Definition.

• Access Control, Entitlement, Retention, and Deletion Requirements.

• Auditability and Data Traceability Requirements.

• Future-State Process Recommendations.

• Prioritized Business Requirements and Remediation Roadmap. Primary Outcome: A comprehensive understanding of business and governance gaps, with actionable recommendations to establish an efficient, compliant, and traceable data in-licensing process.

jobs.description:
The Business Analyst supports the Customer Care Exchange team as a hands-on analyst and Subject Matter Expert (SME). The role sits between Operations, Product, Automation and the Customer Care leaders. It supports IPA and GFax processes, finds and fixes process gaps, builds team knowledge through training and PKTs (Process Knowledge Tests), and uses AI and low code tools such as Claude, Slack AI, Agentforce and Microsoft Power Apps to automate workflows where it makes sense. The role also gives regular SME help to CSAs and other BAs and takes an active part in day to day customer escalations. The individual works across Product, Customer Care, Automation, Technology and GHX India
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**IPA and GFax Support & Team Upskilling:**

* Provide day-to-day support on IPA and GFax cases, issues and questions raised by Customer Care teams.
* Work with product teams to understand releases, changes and fixes, and upskill self first and then the wider team

**Process Gap Identification & Improvement:**

* Review how work is handled to find process gaps, repeat issues and avoidable effort, and map current state and future state processes.
* Run root cause analysis (5 Whys, Fishbone, Pareto), define corrective and preventive actions, and track whether they worked.
* Give leaders clear training and enhancement inputs covering the gap, the impact and a suggested fix.
* Check processes against compliance and data privacy requirements.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Customer Resolution:**

* Work closely with product teams, other departments and CX functions to support customers and reach resolutions, acting as the link between Customer Care, Product, Automation and Technology.
* Raise enhancement requests and customer issue trends with Product or IT, and follow up until closed.
* Keep Customer Care teams updated on known issues, workarounds and status.

* Use Claude, Slack AI, Agentforce and Microsoft Power Apps to find manual or repetitive work and automate workflows as and when needed.
* Own the process side of tool changes, such as Salesforce macros, templates and automation rules, and evaluate tools to recommend the best option.

* Build and maintain KPI and quality dashboards in Power BI or Excel, set KPI baselines and targets, and track trends month to month.
* Analyze cost per case, productivity, capacity and customer feedback (CSAT) trends to support business cases and decisions.
* Prepare leadership updates and executive presentations with clear recommendations, and run workshops and requirement sessions with stakeholders.

* Hands on experience with Salesforce, including case management, reports and Knowledge.

* Practical use of AI tools (Claude, Slack AI, Agentforce) and Microsoft Power Apps and Power Automate to automate workflows.
* Proficiency in Excel, SQL or Power BI to extract, analyze and report on data.

**Core Business Analyst Competencies:**

* Strong verbal and written communication, able to present findings and recommendations to teams and leaders.
* Ability to coach CSAs and peers, and to handle customer escalations calmly with a focus on resolution.

jobs.description:
**Job title: Order to Cash Data & Business Analytics Expert**

* Location: Hyderabad

**About The Job**
Sanofi is a global life sciences company committed to improving access to healthcare and supporting the people we serve throughout the continuum of care. From prevention to treatment, Sanofi transforms scientific innovation into healthcare solutions, in human vaccines, rare diseases, multiple sclerosis, oncology, immunology, infectious diseases, diabetes and cardiovascular solutions. As a company with a global vision of drug development and a highly regarded corporate culture, Sanofi is recognized as one of the best pharmaceutical companies in the world and is pioneering the application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) with strong commitment to develop advanced data standards to increase reusability & interoperability and thus accelerate impact on global health.
  
  
Our Order to Cash (O2C) team aims for excellence, equipping Sanofi with a robust core model, seconded with best of breed digital solutions embedding artificial intelligence and machine learning functionalities. Our international presence, our ambition to become a global reference player for all order to cash related processes mean that our team works on a variety of projects with opportunities for a rich mix of work. This leads to a challenging and stimulating professional experience full of growth and learning. Business Operations is a Global organization of Sanofi providing end to end services to all geographies in Europe, North America, China, JPAC & International regions and covering Global Procurement services, Operations and transition management, medical activities hub, People services, and Global Finance services. Global Finance services homedical following service lines O2C, A2R, Financial sanctions compliance.
  
  
Over the past two years, Global Finance Services has doubled in size and increased its scope. As one department within Business Operations, we’re also part of something much bigger. This provides opportunities for learning, growing, job moves and a diversified, fulfilling career. Order To Cash (O2C) service line, one of the pillars of Business Operations Finance services, is currently covering the following areas
  
  

* Master data Management
* Sales orders Management
* Requests and Disputes Management
* Credit Risk and Credit Data Management
* Collections and Customer Contact Management
* Cash Application and Receivables Management
* AR related Month-end Closing, Reporting and Non-trade Invoice Management

These operations are critical for customers & patients’ products fulfillment, accurate accounting, generating cash flow, and customer satisfaction.
  
  
As Order to Cash Data & Business Analytics Expert within our Global Finance Services Order to Cash team, you'll turn data into insights that improve how we serve customers, collect cash, and run our processes. Ready to get started?
  
  
Join the team that powers Sanofi from within, streamlining how we work, scaling bold ideas, and accelerating impact across the business. In our Business Operations Hubs, you'll help shape smarter, data-driven Order to Cash processes (from sales orders to cash application) that support customers and help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. You'll work with colleagues across the globe, using analytics, automation, and AI to drive continuous improvement.
  
  
**Main Responsibilities**

* Build and improve dashboards, KPIs, and reports that help teams monitor efficiency, spot deviations, and follow process adherence.
* Analyze Order to Cash data and share clear, actionable insights with Global Process Leads, Business System Owners, and Hub teams.
* Translate business needs into Power BI visualizations and turn them into user stories and tasks for developers.
* Train and support colleagues so that data is understood, trusted, and used in everyday decisions.
* Put our data governance approach into practice, keeping data accurate, high quality, secure, and compliant.
* Resolve data quality issues at the source and work with other teams to align data definitions and data sharing across processes.
* Keep master and reference data consistent across systems and applications and check the accuracy of data from internal and external sources.

**About You**

* Experience: Proven experience in analytics and a strong understanding of Order to Cash activities, with good business sense.
* Technical skills: Hands-on experience with Power BI and RPA, and solid SAP knowledge. Experience with Agile ways of working, Jira/Confluence, Microsoft Lists, or Python is a plus.
* Soft skills: Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, strong problem-solving and analytical thinking, and the ability to train others and present ideas clearly.
* A self-starter who takes initiative, works independently under pressure, and delivers excellent service to customers.
* Languages: Excellent English (written and spoken). Other European languages are an advantage.

**Why choose us?**

* Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.
* Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
* Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.
* Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention, and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave.
* Opportunity to work in an international environment, collaborating with diverse business teams and vendors, working in a dynamic team, and fully empowered to propose and implement innovative ideas.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
  
  
Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
  
  
From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
  
  
Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
  
  
Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
  
  
Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
  
  
We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
  
  
But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
  
  
**What We Need**

* Data-native PM — you think in funnels, cohorts, and experiments before PRDs. You write SQL, build dashboards, and catch insights nobody asked you to find.
* Hands-on with AI agents — you've actually built something with LLMs, not just read about them. Prompt engineering is table stakes.
* Entrepreneur DNA — you've tried building something of your own (a startup, a side project, a 0→1 product) or you're a seasoned Growth PM who's operated across the full acquisition-to-revenue loop.
* Business-grade judgment — you hold your own in revenue conversations, understand unit economics, and translate growth levers into P&L impact.

**This is not a feature PM role.**
There's no stable roadmap someone hands you. You define problems, find levers, ship fast, and measure what matters.
  
  
**What You'll Do -**

* Build Customer Empathy: PMs have to regularly meet and understand customer needs first-hand as well as stay on top of the customer pulse via secondary insights - both qualitative and quantitative.
* Devise Strategy: Define both long-term strategy and quarterly roadmap to achieve the product vision and create impact.
* Conceptualize new solutions: Product Conceptualization with a problem first, data-driven, and test & iterate approach. Ensures conceptualization from a platform and a long-term view. Ensures value-based prioritization of product initiatives.
* Build products: Collaborate with Engineering and ecosystem players to build products that customers love. Produce high-quality product specifications and effectively prioritize and manage the scope of each product launch to deliver products and features on time.
* Launch products: Draft and execute a go-to-market plan in conjunction with Product Marketing. Be the internal and external authority and advocate for your given area of focus.
* Ecosystem collaboration: Self-starter to collaborate closely with ecosystem players to co-build products that don’t exist

**Mandatory Qualifications**

* You are obsessed with users but grounded in business and data.
* You have 6+ years of experience in product management with at least 2 years focused on growth or PLG initiatives.
* You're hands-on, hungry, and thrive in fast-paced environments.
* You have a strong command over product analytics and experimentation frameworks.
* You understand technology deeply enough to work well with engineers, but your core superpower is thinking from a customer-first and business-first lens.
* You think in systems, love solving root problems, and approach prioritization through impact and effort.
* You’re structured in thinking, biased for action, and love taking ownership end-to-end.
