jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Job summary

As a Senior Associate in the International Consumer Banking Risk Data Office, you will assume ownership of the current set of risk modeling data models and views, including the setup and maintenance of modeling-specific data tables. You will create and maintain dbt transformation rules, blueprint files, and data dictionaries; automate key processes; maintain Apache Airflow workflows supporting the ongoing performance monitoring process; and deliver required data reporting. You will collaborate with model risk stakeholders and technology teams to translate monitoring requirements into clear data requirements, transformation logic, and consumable datasets.

Job responsibilities

* Collaborate with model risk stakeholders (for example, model owners, validators, ongoing performance monitoring leads, risk data owners, and technology teams) to translate ongoing performance monitoring and model monitoring requirements into clear data requirements, transformation logic, and consumable datasets.
* Design, build, and maintain scalable Amazon Web Services-based data lake tables and curated datasets using dbt and Trino, aligned to Medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold) and best-practice modeling approaches for monitoring, analytics, and reporting.
* Create and maintain dbt transformation rules and supporting governance artifacts, including developing blueprint files for attribute tagging (for example, ongoing performance monitoring metrics, thresholds, segmentation attributes, critical data elements, and sensitivity/classification where applicable) and maintaining data dictionaries and business/technical definitions, along with end-to-end data lineage documentation and logic traceability to model monitoring requirements.
* Analyze, onboard, and integrate new data sources required for ongoing performance monitoring (model inputs, outputs, outcomes, performance labels, and operational/process data), including source profiling, quality assessment, and mapping to monitoring metrics.
* Implement, govern, and operationalize data quality standards for ongoing performance monitoring datasets (completeness, accuracy, timeliness, uniqueness, and referential integrity) using dbt expectations and reusable dbt macros to support consistency, maintainability, and auditability.
* Build and maintain Apache Airflow workflows to automate end-to-end ongoing performance monitoring data processing, including orchestration, scheduling, dependency handling, backfills, monitoring/alerting, and operational runbooks.
* Automate key processes supporting model monitoring (for example, metric dataset refreshes, segmentation datasets, challenger/benchmark feeds, and monitoring aggregations) to improve control, reduce manual effort, and increase scalability.
* Execute and support data migrations relevant to model risk monitoring (platform upgrades, source changes, and dataset redefinitions), ensuring robust planning, validation, reconciliation, and controlled delivery aligned to governance requirements.
* Operate key governance controls across data quality, data protection, data use, and data retention/destruction, aligned to Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS) 239 principles and risk-management expectations for monitored, controlled data products.
* Ensure operational excellence for ongoing performance monitoring data products, including production readiness, incident triage, root-cause analysis, remediation, and continuous improvement to reduce defects and improve monitoring sustainability.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

* Hold a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (for example, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or Statistics) and have 7+ years of experience in data engineering, data management, analytics, or related roles.
* Demonstrate a strong understanding of model risk concepts and the needs of ongoing performance monitoring, with the ability to translate monitoring and control requirements into resilient data models and pipelines.
* Apply advanced SQL skills (window functions, joins, common table expressions, and complex aggregations), including performance tuning and building scalable analytical datasets.
* Bring strong hands-on experience with Amazon Web Services data platforms and modern engineering tooling, including dbt, dbt expectations, Trino, Python, and GitHub (or equivalent software development lifecycle tooling).
* Show proven experience building scalable dbt models using incremental processing techniques and designing reusable dbt macros to improve consistency, maintainability, and auditability.
* Communicate effectively across Risk and Technology teams, with experience working in Agile environments.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

* Have experience with model monitoring datasets and patterns such as performance metrics, drift/stability monitoring, segmentation, thresholds, and outcomes/labels alignment (where applicable to the model type).
* Bring experience with Python data libraries (for example, pandas and numpy) and descriptive statistics concepts supporting monitoring and data quality analysis.
* Demonstrate proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and Microsoft Office.

  
**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

jobs.description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Domain focus: Portfolio-wide product governance and vendor management across all security product domains.**

**Job Purpose:**

  

Run day-to-day vendor governance for the managed service under delegated authority over SLA enforcement and service credits, escalating commercial breach to the function head. You own the security portfolio that sits behind it — the tool estate, its contracts and its renewal calendar — including oversight of platform support as it transitions to the vendor.

**About the team**:

Design Assurance and Product Management makes sure security is designed in before anything is built, and that GSK's security capabilities are run as products rather than projects. Design Assurance independently verifies that solutions meet the architecture standards set elsewhere in Cyber Architecture and Solutions; it writes none of those standards, and that separation is what makes the review worth anything. Product Management owns the security portfolio, vendor governance and investment analytics, and is how GSK manages its managed service vendor as a whole. Platform support engineering moves into this function, with a small internal team retaining oversight while the vendor operates more than 30 platforms and the data fabric under an OTO model. Seventeen roles.

**What makes this role different.** This role is commercial and contractual as much as technical. You will hold a vendor to account on performance and cost for services GSK depends on, where your levers are contractual rather than direct operational control. The OTO transition for platform support happens on your watch, and the operational risk during it is real. If your background is running services rather than governing ones you do not control, that is the transition to be ready for.

**Key responsibilities:**

This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following:

  

* Own vendor governance for the managed service as a whole: performance, SLA management, escalation and commercial levers.
* Run the vendor governance forums and keep decisions and rationale traceable.
* Own oversight of platform support as it moves into the function and transitions to the OTO model.
* Hold accountability for outcomes across more than 30 vendor-operated platforms and the data fabric, while the vendor operates them.
* Own the security portfolio view across products, projects and vendor services.
* Escalate systemic vendor issues rather than managing the same failure repeatedly.
* Hold the vendor to the delivery commitments in each domain product owner's roadmap, and escalate missed milestones through the Vendor Governance Board rather than renegotiating them bilaterally.
* Bring vendor performance evidence — SLA attainment, service credit history and cost per platform — to the annual portfolio review so renewal decisions are made on evidenced delivery rather than incumbency.
* Hold the vendor relationship personally — you have no team, and your leverage is the contract, the governance forum and the evidence you bring to it.
* Support audit and regulatory evidence requests relating to vendor governance.
* Lead your team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and follow GSK's Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.
* Hold the boundary with Procurement and Legal explicitly: this role sets the commercial requirement and the performance case, Procurement negotiates and Legal contracts.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* 15+ years in cyber security in a regulated environment — domain focus: portfolio-wide product governance and vendor management across all security product domains
* Operating vendor governance beneath a product management operating model — SLA regime design, service credit mechanics, escalation ladders and QBR and EBC cadence across a multi-tower managed service.
* Translating threat and risk intelligence into capability investment decisions, running the annual portfolio review with a product owner, business case and renewal decision for every tool
* Chairing the Vendor Governance Board — SLA performance, commercial management and relationship health — with automated reporting and acting as primary interface to Procurement
* Governing AI-enabled security products and vendors' use of AI — AI feature claims, data usage terms and AI risk in contracts

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Product management discipline — roadmaps, adoption metrics and decommission business cases
* Portfolio analytics, licence utilisation and renewal calendar management, with dashboards and renewal alerts automated
* Product or portfolio management certification (Pragmatic Institute, MSP or equivalent)
* Regulated industry experience, including GxP

* Stakeholder management across CISO, Procurement and domain product owners
* Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

**About Fulfillment IQ (FIQ)**

Fulfillment IQ is a supply chain engineering and transformation company that helps brands, retailers, and 3PLs design, build, and scale high-performance logistics operations.

We work at the intersection of strategy, supply chain, and technology where we solve complex, real-world problems across warehouse design, automation, order management, transportation, and end-to-end supply chain execution.

Our teams combine deep domain expertise with strong technical capability, delivering outcomes through consulting, systems implementation, and proprietary platforms that accelerate time-to-value and reduce delivery risk.

If you enjoy working in complex environments, partnering closely with clients, and seeing your work make a tangible impact on how global commerce moves, this is the place where your skills and judgment truly come to life.

**Role Overview**

This role supports FIQ client engagements where the warehouse runs on an IBM i (iSeries / AS/400) WMS, such as Manhattan WMi (PkMS), Blue Yonder (JDA) WMS on IBM i, or a comparable legacy platform. The primary focus is WMS data: getting accurate, timely data out of DB2 and into the hands of operations, reporting, and leadership teams, then supporting the integrations and system changes that depend on it.

You'll work with distribution and fulfillment clients across manufacturing, retail, and 3PL, alongside client configuration and operations leads, BI developers, and FIQ's onshore and offshore delivery teams. This is a techno-functional seat: strong SQL and data skills come first, backed by enough warehouse process knowledge to know what the data means. Depending on the engagement, the work extends into WCS, LMS, ERP, and MHE integration, testing and go-live support, and helping clients modernize, whether that means moving to a modern data platform or migrating from a legacy WMS to a cloud WMS.

**Mandate**

* Extract, transform, and deliver WMS data from DB2 on iSeries to BI and reporting platforms
* Own the WMS data model on each engagement: table structures, relationships, and field definitions
* Turn operational questions into accurate, repeatable queries and data feeds
* Support WMS integrations with WCS, LMS, ERP, TMS, and MHE, including data mapping and testing
* Help clients move from ad hoc data pulls toward governed, scalable reporting and modern data platforms

**Must-Have Qualifications**

* Technical: 5+ years as a technical or techno-functional analyst on a WMS running on IBM iSeries (AS/400), such as Manhattan WMi, JDA/Blue Yonder WMS on iSeries, or similar
* Technical: advanced DB2 for i SQL skills, including complex joins, performance tuning, and extracting large data sets quickly and reliably
* Technical: experience building data extracts, views, or pipelines that feed BI and reporting tools (Cognos, Power BI, Tableau, or similar)
* Technical: working knowledge of WMS integrations with WCS, LMS, ERP, TMS, or MHE, including flat file, socket-based, and API-based interfaces
* Functional: solid understanding of warehouse processes (receiving, inventory, replenishment, wave planning and release, picking, packing, shipping) and how they are represented in WMS data
* Functional: experience with data validation and reconciliation, and supporting testing (unit, SIT, UAT) for data and integration changes
* Ways of working: able to ramp quickly in a new client environment, handle high volumes of data requests, and collaborate with onshore and offshore teams
* Travel: able to travel 20-30% to client sites as needed
* Language: professional working proficiency in English, written and spoken

**Nice to Have:**

* RPG, CL, or COBOL experience on IBM i
* Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Snowflake, or other modern data platforms
* Data migration experience from legacy iSeries WMS to cloud WMS (for example, Manhattan Active WM)
* Python or other scripting for data automation
* Manufacturing, retail, or 3PL distribution experience

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Data Extraction and Modeling**

* Write and optimize DB2 SQL to extract inventory, order, wave, labor, and shipping data from iSeries WMS platforms
* Build repeatable extracts, views, and scheduled data feeds for BI developers and analysts
* Document WMS data models, key tables, and field definitions so reporting can scale

**Reporting and Analytics Enablement**

* Partner with BI developers to design data sets that support operational dashboards and KPIs
* Respond to ad hoc data requests from operations and leadership with accurate, timely answers
* Validate and reconcile reporting outputs against source WMS data

**Integration Support**

* Map WMS integration touchpoints, message formats, and data flows with WCS, LMS, ERP, TMS, and MHE
* Troubleshoot integration and data issues, and support changes during system migrations
* Support data movement into modern platforms (for example, Microsoft Fabric) as client roadmaps evolve

**Testing and Knowledge Transfer**

* Write test scenarios and run data validation for SIT and UAT
* Provide on-site support during cutovers and stabilization as needed
* Document queries, integrations, and fixes, and coach client and offshore team members

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Turnaround time on data extraction and ad hoc query requests
* Dashboards and reports live on reliable WMS data within the first 60 days of an engagement
* Data accuracy and reconciliation rate between WMS source and reporting outputs
* Integration and data defects found and resolved before go-live
* Client satisfaction and engagement extensions

**Description**
We are looking for a curious, detail-oriented Business Analyst II to join our team. In this role, you will turn complex operational data into clear insights, define business requirements, and help drive continuous improvement across compliance and verification workflows. You'll collaborate with stakeholders across operations and product to identify gaps, measure performance, and support automation and process improvement initiatives.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Data Analysis & Technical Execution
* Extract, analyze, and interpret large datasets using SQL, Python, Hadoop/Hive, Redshift, Oracle, or NoSQL databases
* Perform diagnostic analysis, root cause analysis, variance analysis, and pattern identification
* Apply data transformations and statistical techniques to generate actionable insights
* Design and maintain automated reporting systems and dashboards
* Validate data quality, flag upstream issues, and maintain data integrity
* Build and implement KPIs with summarized visuals to track metrics globally
* Problem Solving & Decision Support
* Solve ambiguous business problems with limited guidance using analytical approaches
* Distinguish between one-way and two-way doors in decision-making processes
* Conduct comprehensive analysis to support business cases, product pilots, and strategic initiatives
* Provide diagnostic insights and recommendations that drive measurable business impact
* Navigate uncertainty and propose solutions when problems have less well-defined parameters
* Stakeholder Communication & Management
* Tailor communication to audience needs, presenting to leaders up to three levels above
* Translate complex analytical findings into clear formats for all stakeholder levels
* Facilitate productive dialogue, negotiate priorities, and establish shared understanding
* Proactively communicate project status, risks, and roadblocks to reset expectations
* Create plans, communicate requirements, and clarify success criteria
* Project Delivery & Execution
* Scope, drive, and deliver complex projects across multiple teams with minimal supervision
* Manage timelines effectively and proactively identify risks to deliverables
* Deliver consistently high-quality, well-documented work that answers business questions
* Incorporate best practices and set quality checks in all analytical work
* Balance tradeoffs between time, quality, and resources
* Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Partner with Product, Tech, Operations, and other stakeholders
* Act as bridge between different teams to deliver optimized solutions

* Establish and maintain effective working relationships across teams

* Identify and optimize business processes and data methodologies to improve efficiency
* Determine when solutions should be repeatable versus one-time and implement accordingly
* Build flexible, scalable solutions that anticipate business changes
* Contribute to team business strategy using deep business expertise
* Own items on team-level roadmap and begin to influence broader strategy
* Team Development & Leadership
* Mentor and develop junior analysts
* Participate in recruiting and interviewing for the team
* Share knowledge and optimize analytical best practices across the team
* Build trust through consistent delivery and proven business impact

* Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders

* 3+ years analyzing and interpreting data using SQL, Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL, Hadoop/Hive, or similar technologies
* Strong programming skills in Python and SQL with ability to handle large datasets
* Ability to deliver high-quality work with limited guidance

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in computer science, machine learning, engineering, or related fields
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience prioritizing competing demands, scoping large efforts, and negotiating timelines

* Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders
* Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document
